items.proposed: IDH-wildtype is not a selection biomarker (may be listed, but does not count toward any_molecular_selection or candidate_matched_selection)
items.reason: 'glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype (as defined by WHO 2021 Classification of CNS Tumors)' only defines the disease; §5 excludes 'IDH-wildtype used only to define GBM'. No outcome change: EGFR amplification ('Tumor tissue positive for wild-type EGFR amplification') is an eligibility biomarker but is not candidate-matched because the CAR-T is not a candidate.

note: any_molecular_selection is true because of the EGFR amplification entry requirement (both coders), not because of IDH. Lymphodepleting drugs are not named, so not listed.
